name: Mind2Web
summary: Dataset and benchmark for generalist web agents: 2,000+ open-ended tasks on 137 real websites across 31 domains, with crowdsourced action sequences (NeurIPS 2023).
description: Training data is on Hugging Face (`osunlp/Mind2Web`); test splits (cross-task, cross-website, cross-domain) are distributed as a zip to limit contamination and should not be redistributed unzipped. Follow-ups from the same group include Multimodal-Mind2Web (HTML paired with screenshots) and Online-Mind2Web: 300 tasks on 136 live websites, judged by WebJudge, with a public leaderboard. Dataset CC-BY-4.0; code MIT.
